source_policy: Primary author or official project sources only; lessons are adapted, not imported as product requirements

sources.title: Small CLs | eng-practices
sources.lesson: One coherent change; separate refactoring; include real API consumption and tests.
sources.project_application: 每批一个行为闭环，迁移与重构/清理分开。

sources.title: Software Engineering at Google
sources.lesson: Automated, repeatable, bounded migrations with explicit scope and rollback.
sources.project_application: 复用 Git 和现有 bundle 流程，以检查点收敛，不建设通用迁移平台。

sources.title: Branch By Abstraction
sources.lesson: Move clients through an existing stable seam while implementations change gradually.
sources.project_application: 复用当前 Typed ACI/facade；不新建第二个抽象层或执行 owner。

sources.title: Effective harnesses for long-running agents \ Anthropic
sources.lesson: Feature requirements, incremental progress and end-to-end tests address observed premature completion.
sources.project_application: 冻结 32 操作与 18 行为要求，状态由执行回执得出；不采用仅由 agent 编辑 passes 字段的弱约束。

sources.title: SLSA • Provenance
sources.lesson: Artifacts should be traceable to the source and production process.
sources.project_application: 绑定 commit、残余补丁、构建配方、binary hash 和宿主候选。

sources.title: Definitions — reproducible-builds.org
sources.lesson: Same defined inputs should reproduce byte-identical designated build outputs.
sources.project_application: 保留两套独立构建，记录 toolchain/env；仅复制 exe 不构成来源证明。

sources.title: Git - git-merge-tree Documentation
sources.lesson: Merge-tree supports conflict preflight without modifying the worktree or index.
sources.project_application: 复用已执行的隔离三方合并；文本无冲突仍需语义验收。

sources.title: GitHub - github/scientist: :microscope: A Ruby library for carefully refactoring critical paths. · GitHub
sources.lesson: Compare control and candidate outputs/errors; data-mutating paths need special care.
sources.project_application: 采用 A/B/C 隔离 fixture 对照；不对真实写入、process.start 或外部副作用做双跑。

limitations: No claim that every LLM universally prefers rewrites; this plan treats it as a concrete failure mode.
Anthropic findings concern its demonstrated application harness; applicability to this migration is an engineering inference.
No new Scientist/SLSA library or service is introduced; the plan adopts comparison and provenance practices.
Full extracted pages remain in local D:/tmp research, not in source control.
